name: KudoMetrics IndexNow – Automatic URL Submission to Search Engines
author: kudometricsllc

sections.description:
KudoMetrics IndexNow is a free IndexNow plugin for WordPress. It automatically submits your URLs to Bing and other participating search engines when you publish or update content, using the open IndexNow protocol, so you don’t have to submit URLs by hand.

You can also submit any single page, send up to 500 published items in one operation, and review every submission and its response in your WordPress dashboard. There’s no paid API subscription, no external account and no key file to upload. The plugin works alongside your SEO plugin and XML sitemap.

What is the IndexNow protocol?

IndexNow is a free, open protocol that lets websites tell search engines when a page is added, updated or deleted. Participating search engines share these notices with each other, so one notice reaches all of them. Each search engine decides independently whether and when to crawl and index a URL.

Supported search engines

  • Microsoft Bing
  • Yandex
  • Naver
  • Seznam.cz
  • Yep

Not every search engine supports IndexNow. Google doesn’t take part in IndexNow, so this plugin doesn’t submit to Google.

Key features

  • Automatic submission on publish and update – New and updated posts, pages and other selected public post types are submitted automatically. Autosaves and revisions are skipped.
  • Permanent deletion notifications – A deletion notice is sent when a published post is permanently deleted without going to Trash first. A post moved to Trash and deleted later isn’t submitted.
  • Automatic verification key – A unique 32-character hexadecimal IndexNow key is generated for you.
  • Virtual verification-key URL – Your key is served at yourdomain.com/your-key.txt, so there is no file to upload.
  • Manual submission – Enter any page link in Send One Page Link and click Send Page Now to submit it and see the response straight away.
  • Bulk submission – Click Send All My Pages Now under Send All Website Pages to submit up to 500 eligible published items per operation.
  • Post type selection – Under Send Pages Automatically, choose which public post types are submitted. Posts and pages are selected by default, and WooCommerce products can be selected when WooCommerce is active.
  • Adjustable speed limit – Set Speed Limit (Pages Per Minute) from 5 to 200 requests per minute. The default is 30.
  • Submission history – Pages Sent History lists each URL, how it was sent (Publish, Update, Delete, Manual or Bulk), the HTTP response and the time.
  • History pagination and clearing – Show 10, 25, 50 or 100 records per page, and use Clear History whenever you like.
  • Direct requests – Notices go straight from your WordPress server to the official IndexNow endpoint, with no KudoMetrics server in between.
  • Lightweight – Plain PHP with no external libraries.
  • SEO plugin friendly – Works alongside Yoast SEO, Rank Math, All in One SEO and SEOPress.

How it works

  1. You publish or update a post, page or product of a type you’ve selected.
  2. The plugin sends the page URL, your site’s domain name and your verification key to the IndexNow endpoint.
  3. The response is saved in Pages Sent History, so you can see whether IndexNow accepted the notice.
  4. Participating search engines use the notice to discover the change and decide when, or whether, to crawl and index the page.

Submission responses

  • 200 – Successful response from the IndexNow endpoint.
  • 202 – Notice accepted for processing or validation.
  • 403 – Verification key or authorization issue.
  • 429 – Too many requests were sent, so the endpoint asked you to slow down.

A 200 or 202 response means the IndexNow service accepted your notice. It doesn’t confirm that a page is indexed.

Before you start

IndexNow tells search engines about your changes. It doesn’t force them to crawl or index your pages, it doesn’t guarantee rankings or traffic, and it doesn’t replace your XML sitemap or SEO plugin.

Optional: KudoMetrics IndexNow Pro

This free plugin works on its own and doesn’t connect to Google. If you also want Google information inside WordPress, KudoMetrics IndexNow Pro is a premium add-on that extends this plugin with Google Search Console integration, Google indexing-status monitoring, Google Indexing API integration, and additional reporting features.

Pro requires this free plugin to be installed and active. Google Indexing API features are subject to Google’s API permissions and quotas.

External Services

This plugin connects directly to the official IndexNow API to notify participating search engines when content is published, updated, permanently deleted, or submitted manually or in bulk.

  • Service: IndexNow (https://www.indexnow.org)
  • Endpoint: https://api.indexnow.org/indexnow
  • When data is sent: when you publish or update content of a selected post type, when a published post is permanently deleted, and when you use Send Page Now or Send All My Pages Now.
  • Data sent: the URL or URLs being submitted, your site’s host domain name, and your IndexNow verification key.
  • Why: so participating search engines learn that a page was added, changed or removed.
  • IndexNow Terms of Use: https://www.indexnow.org/terms
  • Microsoft Privacy Statement: https://privacy.microsoft.com/en-us/privacystatement

Requests are sent directly from your WordPress server to IndexNow, not through a KudoMetrics server. No account or API key is required.

Privacy

Pages Sent History stores the submitted URL, HTTP response code, response message and timestamp in your WordPress database. Use Clear History to remove these records.

Submitted URLs may contain information in their paths or query parameters, so avoid putting personal information in URLs. IndexNow requests are sent directly from your WordPress server, and no external account is required.
sections.installation:
Install from your WordPress dashboard

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New Plugin and search for “KudoMetrics IndexNow”.
  2. Click Install Now, then Activate.

Install manually

  1. Download the plugin ZIP, then go to Plugins > Add New Plugin > Upload Plugin, choose the ZIP and click Install Now. Or upload the folder to /wp-content/plugins/kudometrics-url-submission-indexnow.
  2. Activate the plugin from the Plugins screen.

Configure and test

  1. After activation, your verification key is created automatically and posts and pages are submitted automatically.
  2. Open URL Submission in your admin menu. Under Send Pages Automatically, check the post types you want in Allowed Post Types.
  3. Set Speed Limit (Pages Per Minute), or keep the default of 30, and click Save My Settings.
  4. In Send One Page Link, enter a URL from your site and click Send Page Now to test.
  5. To submit your existing content, click Send All My Pages Now under Send All Website Pages.
  6. Check the results in Pages Sent History.
sections.faq:
What is IndexNow?

IndexNow is a free, open protocol that lets website owners notify participating search engines when content is added, updated or deleted.

Is the plugin free?

Yes. Automatic, manual and bulk submission, verification key generation and submission history are all free, with no paid API subscription.

Which search engines support IndexNow?

Participating IndexNow search engines, including Microsoft Bing, Yandex, Naver, Seznam.cz and Yep.

Does Google support IndexNow?

No. Google doesn’t take part in IndexNow, and this plugin doesn’t connect to Google Search Console or Google’s Indexing API. Google features are available separately in the optional KudoMetrics IndexNow Pro add-on, which requires this plugin.

Do I need an IndexNow API key or an account?

No. The plugin creates and serves your verification key automatically, and no account registration is needed.

Does it submit new and updated content automatically?

Yes. Content of your selected post types is submitted when it’s published and again whenever you update it. Autosaves and revisions are skipped.

Does it submit deleted pages?

Only in one case: when a published post is permanently deleted without going to Trash first. A post moved to Trash and deleted later isn’t submitted.

How do I submit a URL to Bing from WordPress?

Install and activate the plugin. New and updated content of your selected post types is sent to Bing and the other IndexNow search engines automatically. To send one page by hand, enter its link in Send One Page Link and click Send Page Now.

What is the IndexNow API?

The IndexNow API is the address your site sends a short notice to when a page changes. The plugin sends these notices for you, so there’s no code to write and no key to register.

Can I submit a single page manually?

Yes. Enter the URL in Send One Page Link and click Send Page Now. The response is shown straight away.

How can I check that my IndexNow submissions worked?

Open Pages Sent History to see the HTTP code and result for each URL, or test one page with Send One Page Link and Send Page Now. A 200 or 202 response means IndexNow accepted the notice. It doesn’t mean the page is indexed.

Can I submit many pages at once?

Yes. Click Send All My Pages Now to submit up to 500 eligible published items in one operation. Sites with more than 500 eligible items can’t submit them all in one go.

Does it work with WooCommerce?

Yes. You can select WooCommerce products as a post type when WooCommerce is active. Products are submitted when they’re published or updated. Stock changes caused only by an order are not submitted automatically.

Does it work with Yoast SEO, Rank Math, All in One SEO and SEOPress?

Yes. It works alongside these plugins. Your SEO plugin keeps managing metadata, sitemaps and canonical URLs.

Do I still need an XML sitemap?

Yes. IndexNow tells search engines about changes, while your sitemap helps them understand your whole site. Use both.

Does a successful submission mean my page is indexed?

No. It means the IndexNow service accepted your notice. Search engines independently determine whether and when to crawl or index the URL.

Does it guarantee better rankings or more traffic?

No. The plugin sends discovery notices. It doesn’t guarantee indexing, rankings or traffic.

Can I change the speed limit?

Yes. Speed Limit (Pages Per Minute) can be set between 5 and 200, and the default is 30. If the limit is reached, further requests in that minute aren’t sent.
sections.changelog:
1.0.3

  • Fix: Prevented horizontal clipping of the Date & Time column in Pages Sent History when long URLs are displayed on narrower laptop screens.
  • Improved responsive table wrapping and dashboard sidebar sizing.

1.0.2

  • Updated branding and header UI layout.
  • Added optional Pro add-on features showcase banner.
  • Enhanced responsiveness and visual status guides.

1.0.1

  • Initial release on WordPress.org.
  • Automated URL submission for participating IndexNow search engines: Microsoft Bing, Yandex, Naver, Seznam.cz and Yep.
  • Automated verification key creation and virtual key route handling.
  • Bulk URL submission and manual URL tester.
  • Submission history log with pagination and clear history action.
  • Compatible with WordPress 5.8 through 7.1 and PHP 7.4 through 8.3+.
